title: MIF conformance floor — Level 1 (Core)
description: The MIF core required fields only (@context, @type, a urn:mif:<uuid> @id, conceptType or the deprecated memoryType, content, created), enforced by the canonical schema. No overlay beyond it. MIF 1.4.0 Level 1 also requires the document to sit in an OKF bundle (a directory of .md concept files), which a single-document check cannot see.
